prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent pixel-art fighting game sprite sheet. References are approved Drupa skins. Bottom row oversized thick loose dark purple T-shirt black shorts white shoes. Preserve bald head, beard, stocky heavy belly, identity, crisp pixel style. Keep consistent proportions and natural limbs. No text, effects, shadows, background, grid, or overlapping sprites. Real alpha transparency.
